scope: LU01 checkpoint1 selected actual-source inventory; not an exhaustive claim or spoiler audit
method: Fetched exact-head cosmere.js content; evaluated data registration without an application renderer. Returned GitHub blob SHAs compared with earlier same-run snapshots; no new local hash recomputation.
exclusions: Full generated world gfx.map polygons are omitted from this inventory; no geometric validation performed.
No narrative coverage is implied by inventory presence.
The key12 Dhatri link and era are carried as later-work boundary records.

world.name: Lumar
world.status: World of the spore seas · near the Drominad system
world.distText: Not on the star chart. Close to the Drominad system: under a year by sublight starship (moved apart here to be visible)
world.blurb: There is no water to sail here. Twelve moons hang close overhead, and from each one spores rain down to make an ocean: an emerald sea, a crimson sea, a midnight sea and more. Touch spores with water and they burst. Tress, a girl who collects cups on a dull little island, sets out across these seas to rescue the boy she loves from a Sorceress.
world.short: Seas of spores: Tress of the Emerald Sea.

facts: Twelve, each home to an aether
Emerald, Crimson, Midnight, Sapphire, Rose and more
Part of the Dhatrian planetary network
First of the Sun, under a year by sublight ship
Twelve, each raining its own spore
Emerald, Crimson, Midnight, Sapphire, Rose and more

sites.name: Diggen’s Point (the Rock)
sites.desc: A crooked finger of black saltstone in the Emerald Sea, 50 or 60 miles from the green lunagree, with a small town and the duke’s mansion near the top. Tress works here and collects cups.

sites.name: The Emerald Sea
sites.desc: The green Verdant Sea, Tress’s home sea, piled highest under its moon’s spore-fall.

sites.name: Kingsport (Core Archipelago)
sites.desc: Probably the royal city of the Verdant king, in the Core Archipelago far from the Rock. Position is our placeholder.

sites.name: The Crimson Sea
sites.desc: Red spores that throw up spike-forests in sudden squalls. The dragon Xisis lies in a lair near its lunagree. It borders the Midnight Sea and is one of the few ways in.

sites.name: The Midnight Sea
sites.desc: Black, warm spores, walled in by mountains on four sides; the Sorceress’s domain.

sites.name: The Sorceress’s island
sites.desc: A small, suspiciously round island in the Midnight Sea near the Crimson border, with a silver tower that is really a starship.

sites.name: The Rose Sea
sites.desc: A pink, inhabited sea bordering the Emerald.

sites.name: The Sapphire Sea
sites.desc: The blue Zephyr Sea in the north, home of the Islands of Lobu and the Zephyr Islands.

sites.name: The Islands of Lobu
sites.desc: Large islands of the Sapphire Sea with a hunting culture; home of Fort and Salay.

events.title: Tress sets sail
events.text: When the duke’s son is sent off to the Sorceress, Tress leaves her island to get him back.

events.title: The Sorceress’s island
events.text: With a pirate crew and an unusual narrator, Tress reaches the Midnight Sea and forces the Sorceress to leave the world.

adjacentSites.name: The Lilting Abyss
adjacentSites.desc: An extraordinarily deep trench in the ocean between the continents, mentioned in Tress.

codex.name: Hoid (Wit)
codex.desc: A storyteller who turns up on almost every world under another name, older than he looks.
more: He was on Yolen at the Shattering.
Goes to Scadrial for help after Roshar falls.

codex.name: Tress
codex.desc: A practical girl from the Rock who becomes a captain.

codex.name: Worldhoppers
codex.desc: People who cross between worlds, usually through the Cognitive Realm.
more: Silverlight is their crossroads, and its codes set rules for visitors.
By the 2023 books there are starships as well.
